Dataset 3: Manga Inpainting & Text Removal Dataset (Matnni O'chirish va Fonni Tiklash)
Ushbu ma'lumotlar to'plami manga sahifalaridagi matnlarni o'chirish, nutq buluti ichidagi oq fonni tekislash hamda eng muhimi — kadr foni (screentone, chiziqlar, rasmlar) ustiga tushgan SFX va matnlarni badiiy tasvirni buzmasdan qayta tiklash (Inpainting) modellarini (LaMa, MangaInpainting, FcF) o'qitish uchun mo'ljallangan.
1. Asosiy Ochiq Manbalar (Open-Source Inpainting Datasets & Models)
MangaInpainting Repository (GitHub): SIGGRAPH 2021 maqolasi asosida yaratilgan, manga screentone va chiziqlarini tiklovchi eng mashhur semantik inpainting modeli.
LaMa (Large Mask Inpainting) (Hugging Face): Katta o'lchamli maskalarni va murakkab to'qimalarni (texture) mukammal tiklovchi neyrotarmoq.
sd-webui-manga-inpainting (GitHub): Manga uchun ControlNet va LaMa modellarini birlashtirgan tozalash moduli.
2. Inpainting Dataset Standart Formati (Triplet Sxemasi)
Inpainting modelini o'qitish uchun 3 ta tasvir juftligi (triplet) talab qilinadi:
raw_image: Asl matnli rasm yoki matn chizilgan tasvir.
mask: Faqat o'chirilishi kerak bo'lgan matn qismini ko'rsatuvchi 1-kanalli oq-qora rasm (oq = o'chirish, qora = saqlash).
ground_truth: Toza fon tasviri (hech qanday matnsiz asl kadr).
JSONL Formatidagi Boshqaruv Fayli
{"triplet_id": "inpaint_001", "raw_image": "raw/manga_001_raw.png", "mask": "masks/manga_001_mask.png", "ground_truth": "clean/manga_001_clean.png", "type": "speech_bubble"}
{"triplet_id": "inpaint_002", "raw_image": "raw/manga_002_raw.png", "mask": "masks/manga_002_mask.png", "ground_truth": "clean/manga_002_clean.png", "type": "sfx_on_art"}
{"triplet_id": "inpaint_003", "raw_image": "raw/manhwa_003_raw.png", "mask": "masks/manhwa_003_mask.png", "ground_truth": "clean/manhwa_003_clean.png", "type": "colored_webtoon"}
{"triplet_id": "inpaint_004", "raw_image": "raw/manga_004_raw.png", "mask": "masks/manga_004_mask.png", "ground_truth": "clean/manga_004_clean.png", "type": "screentone_pattern"}
3. Sintetik Dataset Generatori (Python Skripti)
Inpainting o'qitish uchun eng qulay yo'l — toza manga foni ustiga sun'iy ravishda tasodifiy matn chizib, avtomatik ravishda 100% aniq maska va ground_truth juftligini yaratishdir:import os
import cv2
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import random
def generate_synthetic_inpaint_pair(clean_img_path: str, font_path: str, texts: list, output_dir: str, pair_id: int):
clean_img = Image.open(clean_img_path).convert("RGB")
w, h = clean_img.size
# 1. Bo'sh qora maska yaratish
mask = Image.new("L", (w, h), 0)
raw_img = clean_img.copy()
draw_raw = ImageDraw.Draw(raw_img)
draw_mask = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
# Tasodifiy matn va joylashuv
text = random.choice(texts)
font_size = random.randint(20, 60)
try:
font = ImageFont.truetype(font_path, font_size)
except:
font = ImageFont.load_default()
x = random.randint(10, max(11, w - 200))
y = random.randint(10, max(11, h - 200))
# Matnni raw_image ga va maskaga chizish
draw_raw.text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=(0, 0, 0))
draw_mask.text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=255) # Oq rang - maska
# Maskani biroz kengaytirish (dilatation)
mask_np = np.array(mask)
kernel = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (3, 3))
dilated_mask = cv2.dilate(mask_np, kernel, iterations=2)
# Saqlash
os.makedirs(f"{output_dir}/raw", exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(f"{output_dir}/mask", exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(f"{output_dir}/clean", exist_ok=True)
raw_img.save(f"{output_dir}/raw/{pair_id}.png")
clean_img.save(f"{output_dir}/clean/{pair_id}.png")
Image.fromarray(dilated_mask).save(f"{output_dir}/mask/{pair_id}.png")
